{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module LogAgent where

import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.IORef
import Data.Pool
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)
import Data.Aeson (Value(..), object, (.=), encode)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, stderr)

-- Simulated MongoDB connection type
data MongoConn = MongoConn { connId :: Int, connHost :: T.Text }
data MongoQuery = MongoQuery { queryCollection :: T.Text, queryDoc :: Value }
data LogLevel = DEBUG | INFO | WARN | ERROR deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data AgentConfig = AgentConfig
  { cfgPoolSize    :: Int
  , cfgHost        :: T.Text
  , cfgDatabase    :: T.Text
  , cfgCollection  :: T.Text
  , cfgMinLevel    :: LogLevel
  }

data LogEntry = LogEntry
  { logTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , logLevel     :: LogLevel
  , logSource    :: T.Text
  , logMessage   :: T.Text
  , logMetadata  :: [(T.Text, T.Text)]
  }

-- Connection pool management
createAgentPool :: AgentConfig -> IO (Pool MongoConn)
createAgentPool cfg = createPool
  (allocConn (cfgHost cfg))
  freeConn
  1
  30
  (cfgPoolSize cfg)

allocConn :: T.Text -> IO MongoConn
allocConn host = do
  cid <- pure 1  -- simplified
  return $ MongoConn cid host

freeConn :: MongoConn -> IO ()
freeConn _ = return ()

-- Query sanitization layer
data SanitizeMode = Strict | Permissive

sanitizeFieldValue :: SanitizeMode -> T.Text -> T.Text
sanitizeFieldValue Strict val = 
  T.filter (\c -> c /= '$' && c /= '{' && c /= '}') val
sanitizeFieldValue Permissive val =
  T.filter (\c -> c /= '$' && c /= '{' && c /= '}') val

-- The key abstraction: query builder with configurable sanitization
buildLogQuery :: SanitizeMode -> LogEntry -> Value
buildLogQuery mode entry = object
  [ "timestamp" .= show (logTimestamp entry)
  , "level"     .= show (logLevel entry)
  , "source"    .= sanitizeFieldValue mode (logSource entry)
  , "message"   .= sanitizeFieldValue mode (logMessage entry)
  , "metadata"  .= buildMetadata mode (logMetadata entry)
  ]

buildMetadata :: SanitizeMode -> [(T.Text, T.Text)] -> Value
buildMetadata mode pairs = object $
  map (\(k, v) -> k .= sanitizeFieldValue mode v) pairs

-- Determines sanitization mode based on source trust level
resolveSanitizeMode :: T.Text -> IORef [T.Text] -> IO SanitizeMode
resolveSanitizeMode source trustedRef = do
  trusted <- readIORef trustedRef
  if source `elem` trusted
    then return Permissive
    else return Strict

-- Registration endpoint - sources register themselves
registerSource :: IORef [T.Text] -> T.Text -> IO ()
registerSource trustedRef sourceName = do
  modifyIORef trustedRef (sourceName :)
  hPutStrLn stderr $ "Registered trusted source: " ++ T.unpack sourceName

-- Execute query against MongoDB (simulated)
executeInsert :: Pool MongoConn -> T.Text -> Value -> IO ()
executeInsert pool collection doc = do
  withResource pool $ \conn -> do
    -- In real code: MongoDB.insert (connHandle conn) collection doc
    let serialized = BL.toStrict $ encode doc
    hPutStrLn stderr $ "INSERT into " ++ T.unpack collection ++ ": " ++ show serialized
    return ()

-- Main logging pipeline
processLogEntry :: Pool MongoConn -> AgentConfig -> IORef [T.Text] -> LogEntry -> IO ()
processLogEntry pool cfg trustedRef entry = do
  when (logLevel entry >= cfgMinLevel cfg) $ do
    mode <- resolveSanitizeMode (logSource entry) trustedRef
    let query = buildLogQuery mode entry
    executeInsert pool (cfgCollection cfg) query

-- Search/filter endpoint - used by monitoring dashboard
searchLogs :: Pool MongoConn -> AgentConfig -> IORef [T.Text] -> T.Text -> T.Text -> IO ()
searchLogs pool cfg trustedRef source filterExpr = do
  mode <- resolveSanitizeMode source trustedRef
  let sanitizedFilter = sanitizeFieldValue mode filterExpr
  let query = object [ "$where" .= sanitizedFilter ]
  withResource pool $ \conn -> do
    let serialized = BL.toStrict $ encode query
    hPutStrLn stderr $ "FIND in " ++ T.unpack (cfgCollection cfg) ++ ": " ++ show serialized
    return ()

-- Agent initialization
initAgent :: IO (Pool MongoConn, AgentConfig, IORef [T.Text])
initAgent = do
  let cfg = AgentConfig 5 "localhost:27017" "monitoring" "logs" INFO
  pool <- createAgentPool cfg
  trustedRef <- newIORef []
  return (pool, cfg, trustedRef)

-- Example: external API handler that processes incoming log data
handleLogRequest :: Pool MongoConn -> AgentConfig -> IORef [T.Text] -> T.Text -> T.Text -> [(T.Text, T.Text)] -> IO ()
handleLogRequest pool cfg trustedRef source msg metadata = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let entry = LogEntry now INFO source msg metadata
  processLogEntry pool cfg trustedRef entry

-- Example: external API handler for search
handleSearchRequest :: Pool MongoConn -> AgentConfig -> IORef [T.Text] -> T.Text -> T.Text -> IO ()
handleSearchRequest pool cfg trustedRef source query =
  searchLogs pool cfg trustedRef source query
